name: Itiner-e Roman roads — web-display adaptation
description: Roads-only web adaptation of the Itiner-e route-segment export; rivers and sea lanes omitted and road geometry simplified.
citation: Brughmans, T., de Soto, P., Pažout, A. and Bjerregaard Vahlstrup, P. (2024), Itiner-e: the digital atlas of ancient roads.
adaptation: Filtered to Main Road and Secondary Road; Douglas-Peucker tolerance 0.0025 degrees; coordinates rounded to 5 decimals.
